# PDF {#sec-pdf}

```{r,warning=FALSE, messages=FALSE,echo=FALSE}

Directory<-getwd

#Settings
CHECK_BUN_CREA_RATIO <- FALSE #Flag Mismatched Bun/Creatinine ratios

ANNOATE_FLAGGED_ONLY <- TRUE #TRUE = pictures only draw boxes for flagged / uncertain values (orange)
```
